parent_source_study: original 8 EDF real-source study run 38336887369 and independent audit 38337809594
chronological_holdout_fraction: last ceil(N/3) event epochs per run, first N-ceil(N/3) as train, ties follow sorted sample index
event_epoch_overlap_policy: fail if any chronological train/test event crop overlaps in raw samples; no purging changed posthoc
preprocessing: fixed SciPy sosfiltfilt Butterworth order 4, 1–30 Hz, entire original EDF recording independently for each run
synthetic_intervention: flip signs of ORIGINAL raw C3/C4 samples within the union of all heldout test-event epoch crops, before whole-run filtering. This is counterfactual source contamination, not natural leakage or label corruption.
feature: 8–12 Hz and 13–30 Hz Hann-windowed FFT mean squared amplitudes per C3/C4 channel, log clip floor 1e-20, four features per epoch
counterfactual_design: train same actual train event labels/epochs with features filtered on clean vs test-crop-flipped WHOLE raw run; always evaluate on ORIGINAL clean heldout test features. Do not retrain/tune threshold or use any test labels outside evaluation.
negative_controls: When the heldout crop is masked identically from both clean/perturbed source before filter, train epoch features must be bit-identical
Between separate EDF R04 and R08, heldout run perturbation cannot affect independently filtered training file
primary_endpoints: paired original heldout event predicted-probability absolute change mean/max
paired original heldout label predicted-class flips
paired unchanged-test accuracy clean versus source-perturbed training as diagnostic ONLY
number of source train epochs with nonzero learned-input drift
statistical_unit: 4 independent people, with 2 runs and multiple event trials repeated, not 8 independent subjects
registered_cells: 8 within-record chronological train/test fold contrasts, 4 participants with 2 EDF recordings each
important_boundary: Underlying training event epochs never overlap selected test event epochs in raw samples. Within-record entire-run zero-phase filtering can still carry test-source dependence. Across-run processing is independent by construction.
stop_rules: fail if any subject/run missing labels T1/T2 or either split lacks both classes
fail if any training/test event crop directly overlaps or outside EDF
fail if original train split differs between clean and perturbed versions
fail if original clean evaluation heldout trial features changed
fail if intermediate solver fails or JSON nonfinite
do not remove runs with zero diagnostic effect or no accuracy change
non_claims: This does NOT demonstrate label leakage
This is not a clinical or independent-hospital EEG study
Nonzero signal influence may not change classification
No claim that numerical guard improves actual task accuracy
No upstream MOABB API merge implies from this test
